methodology.evidence: Official vendor documentation, release pages, and vendor-owned Hugging Face/GitHub only. Null means not established in this research, never zero.
methodology.publication_dates: Only explicit dates. A documentation update is identified separately from a model release date. Model IDs are not parsed into assumed release dates.
methodology.integration: Research suggestions only. Match existing_model_id. Do not overwrite historical benchmark rows when an API alias changes checkpoint. Apply verified fields with their conditions; review conflicts and null fields.
methodology.numeric_units: Token limits in tokens; parameters in parameters; token prices in USD per 1000000 tokens unless a record explicitly states another currency/unit. Marketing K limits are preserved with a normalization note; binary expansions require explicit corroboration. Ambiguous K abbreviations retain an official raw-label field and optional decimal-display-only number; exact token scalar remains null. Never apply display_normalization_only as a verified hard limit.
methodology.runtime: No paid inference calls, cloud execution, model downloads, asset downloads, commits or deployment performed.
methodology.fact_provenance: Each field/pricing/event fact object supplies source_ids plus direct URLs, checked date, explicit source dates, conditions and conflict status. Nested values inherit that fact object's provenance. Structural IDs, keys and research-scope metadata are editorial/local.
